title: Guru Parampara of Shri Shiroor Matha

items.name: Sri Madhwacharyaru
items.summary: Sri Madhwacharyaru is described on the official About page as the third avatar of Lord Vayu. He appeared to establish Tatvavada (Pure Dualism). Through commentaries on the Brahma Sutras, Upanishads, Bhagavad Gita, and other sacred texts, he illuminated the path of unwavering devotion to Lord Vishnu and established the foundation of the spiritual lineage.
